source.method: objdump linear scan of named functions plus reviewed rules pinned by address

gates.rule: An `os` attribute, when present, must equal `mac` exactly (a three-byte, case-sensitive compare); otherwise the factory returns no object.
`ISkinObject::checkCondition` must pass; otherwise the factory returns no object.

factory.comparison: Each branch tests the name's length first, then `strIsEqualCI`: an exact, case-insensitive match. Branches are tried in order and the first match wins.

default.rule: A name no branch matches returns no object, without a diagnostic.

selector.rule: Constructs CSkinSlider, the same constructor as `slider`.
With a `group` attribute present: CSkinTextGroup; otherwise CSkinText.
Shares the `text` branch: a `group` attribute selects CSkinTextGroup.

effect.rule: Loads dialog styling (`DLGItem::load`) and stores `darkmode` (default true) in a global; no object.
Creates a top-level CSkinWindow, appends it to the engine's window list and loads it from this node; no child object is returned.
Compiles `action` with `IAction::create` into the engine's load-action list; no object.
As `onload`, into the same list, but only when an engine field is non-zero; the field's meaning is unresolved.
Compiles `action` into the engine's exit-action list; no object.
Copies the node into a global XML node (the default font definition); no object.

selector.rule: Constructed only while a global flag byte is clear; when it is set the name falls through the remaining branches and returns no object.

effect.rule: Loads `file` as an image and passes `x`, `y`, `iconsize`, `nb`, `nbx` to `CBrowser::initIcons`; no object.

selector.rule: `orientation` equal to `circle` or `vertical`: a CSkinSlider bound to `song_pos`; otherwise CSkinSongPos.
Constructed with the split named `effects` (`CSkinSplit::getSkinSplit`) as its container.

effect.rule: Registers a class definition (`CSkinClass::add`); no object. Its expansion rules are task K3.

CSkinPanel::loadChildren.used_by: panel, group (with visibility), window, the skin root, stack items

rules.rule: If it has children: sets the current deck from its `deck` attribute, loads its children into the same owner, then restores the deck. No condition is checked. With no children it is skipped.
Creates a top-level window from the node; nothing is added to the owner.

Without `visibility` or `novisibility`: checks its condition, adds its `x`/`y` to the owner's offset, loads its children into the owner and restores the offset. With either attribute it goes to the factory and becomes a CSkinPanel.
Created by the factory but inserted first in the owner's child list, not appended.
Every other child goes to the factory. Objects carrying a panel index are regrouped afterwards into generated containers. Child XML nodes are freed once processed.
Sets the current deck from `deck` and loads its children as rack children.
Becomes a rack unit (`CSkinRack::addUnit`). No other tag is matched here.
Sets the current deck from `deck` and loads its children as unit children.
Constructs CSkinResizePanel, not CSkinPanel. No other tag is matched here.
Supplies geometry: `x`, `y` (signed, relative) and `width`, `height`.
Its `visibility` is compiled with `CSkinEngine::createAction` and removed from the node, then the item becomes a CSkinPanel. No other tag is matched here.
When present, its children are dispatched instead of the panel's own; it is not an object itself.
`type="vertical"` selects children `up`/`down`, otherwise `left`/`right`; each side becomes an ISkinResizePanel.
Read for the separator's geometry and colour.
Each becomes a menu entry (`SSkinMenuItem`). No other tag is matched here.
Takes `text` (localized) and a compiled `visibility`; a `submenu` holds nested `item`, `submenu` and `separator` entries, while an item compiles `action` and `check`.
A separator entry.
Each `choice` child is added to the multibutton group named by `id` (`CMultiButton::add`); the group's choices are cleared first.
The root element is loaded as the main CSkinWindow (`CSkinWindow::load`); its own name is not compared. The engine reads `image`, `version`, `touchScreenMode` and `nbdecks` from it first.
A child named `nbdecks` whose condition passes sets the deck count from its `value`.

open_rules: oninit: meaning of the engine field that gates it
browser: meaning of the global flag that suppresses it
factory selectors and loaders beyond those reviewed above are listed only as sites

limitations: Tier 2 structure: recognition and construction paths, not runtime behaviour.
The scan is linear: it does not follow branches, so a role lists every consumer seen.
A tag_compare's receiver is not proven to be a node name; value_compare is used only when the compared string is a getParam result.
Only functions named CSkin*/ISkin*/SSkin* and the factory's named helpers are scanned.
